item.title: Gauhati HC Allows Ancillary Work on ₹498-Crore Kamakhya Corridor, Bars Any Alteration to Temple Structure
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Gauhati High Court has permitted the Assam government to proceed with limited preparatory and ancillary work under the ₹498-crore Kamakhya Corridor project, while firmly directing that the main shrine remain untouched. item.title: Modi to Lay Foundation Stone for Silchar–Shillong–Guwahati High Speed Corridor During Third Assam Visit This Year
item.description: GUWAHATI: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to visit Assam in March to lay the foundation stone for the Silchar–Shillong–Guwahati High-Speed Corridor, marking his third visit to the state this year. item.title: Guwahati Airport’s New Terminal to Open for Passengers from Feb 22
